messages:
Evelyn Moore: Hi team, quick day-one Q — I started jotting ramp notes in my private Notion. Should I move them to the shared Onboarding folder now or keep them private until review?
Liam O'Sullivan: welcome Evelyn! :wave: Duplicate the 'New Hire Notes' template from DevEx, keep it private for a couple days, then move to Shared / Onboarding / 2026 once youre ready to share.
Hannah Park: Also, add your manager + buddy as editors before you move. We prefer naming like 2026-03_Moore_Evelyn_Ramp so it sorts by year.
Docs Bot: Automated: Received ACL update request for folder 'Shared / Onboarding / 2026'. Ticket DOC-5012. DevEx will apply changes within 24 hours.
Evelyn Moore: Cool, thanks. Any must-have sections in the template?
Liam O'Sullivan: Top three: access checklist, 7-day goals, and a weekly checkpoint block. The template already has those.
Hannah Park: If you DM me the page link after duplication Ill drop the team kickoff checklist into it and set the page properties (Owner, Visibility).
Evelyn Moore: Perfect 10 I'll duplicate and ping you both. Thanks!
